excerpt.zh:
我们没能成功地给这位神秘访客提供合适的营养：该生物很快就生病了，它拒绝餐食，还拒绝作出任何应答。

在我们能够进一步了解它的新陈代谢机制之前，通讯行为暂时停止。
excerpt.en:
Our attempts to provide our mysterious visitor with suitable nourishment have failed: the creature quickly sickened, expelled the meal, and is currently unresponsive.

Communication efforts are on hold until we can gain a better understanding of its metabolism
